page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes at the right edge (Greek phrase, "ut loquitur", "Aristot.") beside the last lines; running head at top.

main_text.p: quandoquidem linea d b, æqualis est lineæ b a, & linea b d, æqualis est lineæ b a, & lineæ a d: triangula ergo a t i, b g i, sunt æqualia æqualium laterum & æqualium angulorum. Connectantur hæc per lineam t g, & construe tur triangulum t g i, æquale ipsis. Nam tres rectæ lineæ æquales connexæ necessario efficiunt æqualium laterum triangulum. Nam subtendentia latera a t, b g, triangulorum a t i, b g i, necessario sunt æqualia lateri t g, triangu li g t i, quandoquidem latus hoc conexum est cum lineis t i, g i, per media latera a d, b d, trianguli a b d. quoniam igitur triangulum t g i, æquale est triangulis a t i, b g i, triangulum quoque t g d, illis erit æquale. quoniam enim basis ipsius est circa media latera a d, b d, trianguli a b d, erit æqualis lateribus t i, g i, trianguli t g i: quorum enim dimidia sunt æqualia & ipsa tota sunt æqualia.

Quoniam igitur quatuor triangula a t i, b g i, t g i, t g d, in triangulo a b d, sunt æqualia: triangula quoque quatuor a x i, b o i, o x i, o x c, in triangulo a b c, erunt inter se æqualia, quandoquidem diameter a b, circuli q h, est commune latus utriusque trianguli æqualium angulorum & æqualiū laterum nempe a b d, a b c, quæ vero æqualia sunt, & quartæ partes ipsorum sunt æquales.

Dico igitur octo esse triangula in duob. triangulis æqualibus a b d, a b c, quorum sex a t i, t g i, g b i, b o i, o x i, x a i, spatiū circuli q h, comprehendunt. Supersunt autē x o c, t g d. Segmeta igitur a t, t g, g b, b o, o x, x a, quæ ex circu- currente linea circuli & laterib. triangulorū existūt, sint æqualia duob. triangulis t g d, x o c. Hoc.n. ipse sensus demostrat. Nā t g, segmentū circuli q h, assumpta quātitate a t, b g, cōplebit spatiū triāguli t g d. Eodē modo segmētū

page.notes: Marginal notes at right: Greek "ἀξιωμα λόγων"/"συνθες" (illegible in part), "ut loquitur", "Aristot.". Greek note transcribed only approximately. Several words in the body (e.g. "quartæ", "circuli") are uncertain; the last line of text continues onto the next page.
